description: The course covers the concepts of software development life cycle and project management. It will also include hands-on learning sessions that cover the fundamentals of web development. The module focuses heavily on the development and deployment of web applications. It will be a project-based learning, and the course will cover the following topics: Stages of Software development life cycle Front-end development with HTML+CSS+Javascript Introduction to javascript frameworks like Vue js. Firebase Firestore and deployment with Firebase Version control Project Management methodologies, including SCRUM Introduction to DevOps
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed 1 of "IS1112"/"IS1112FC"/"IS1112X"/BT2102 at a grade of at least D )
